title: Akra a Wɔte Amena no Mu
intro: Wotu kwan san kɔ bere bi a sodifo bi a onni mmɔborohunu hwehwɛe sɛ wɔde wɔn ho ma atoro anyame koraa. Akra a wɔatu wɔn ho ama kuw ketewaa bi powee, na wohyiaa asotwe a emu yɛ den araa ma ɛbɛyɛɛ nnome daa. Wɔn asɛm no nam Kur’aan so ka sɛ gyidi a enhinhim ho adanse. So wubetumi ahu kuw a wogyina pintinn yi?
clues: Ná yɛte asase bi a sodifo bi a ɔhwehwɛ sɛ wɔsom atoro anyame no atirimɔdensɛm ase so
Yɛn mpɔtam hɔfoɔ hyiaa ɔtaa a emu yɛ den wɔ yɛn gyidie a yɛwɔ wɔ Allah nko ara mu nko ara nti
Sodifo no hyɛe sɛ wontutu amena kɛse bi na wɔmfa ogyaframa a ano yɛ den nhyɛ mu
Esiane sɛ yɛampɛ sɛ yɛbɛpo yɛn gyidi nti, wɔtow yɛn guu saa amoa a ɛredɛw no mu mmiako mmiako
Yɛn asɛm no bɛyɛɛ Kur’aan no fã, na wɔadome wɔn a wɔtaa yɛn daa
Surah a ɛkyerɛw yɛn amanehunu no, wɔde ɔsoro nsɛnkyerɛnne akɛseɛ a ɛwɔ soro no din too so

options: Ahokafoɔ a wɔwɔ Amena no mu (Ashab al-Ukhdud) .
Nnipa a wɔwɔ Ɔbodan no mu (Ashab al-Kahf) .
Nnipa a wɔte Homeda
Nnipa a wɔwɔ A'ad
Nnipa a wɔwɔ Thamud
identity.answer: Ahokafoɔ a wɔwɔ Amena no mu (Ashab al-Ukhdud) .

outcome.answer: Wokunkum yɛn wɔ gyidi mu na wɔdomee ɔtaafo no daa

arabic: وَمَا نَقَمُوا۟ مِنْهُمْ إِلَّآ أَن يُؤْمِنُوا۟ بِٱللَّهِ ٱلْعَزِيزِ ٱلْحَمِيدِ
verse: And they resented them not except because they believed in Allāh, the Exalted in Might, the Praiseworthy, (85:8)
